title: 第19章恶客上门感谢上下是星月第20章夜半丧拍门
slug: 我的民俗游戏机第227章权限
content_zh:
有些脱力的回到了车边，师父也不停，将放在了林子旁边的东西都收拾起来，囫囵朝着车上一放，许峰和师父就立刻往回走。
就是在路上，许峰还有心情在想自己在林子之中看到的文字。
土地、日夜游神。
他未曾想过，师父说的打基业，竟然是这般立竿见影的事情。
不过要是叫他再来一次的话——
许峰还是愿意再来一趟。
毕竟在这林子里头，是真的风险和机遇并存。
并且对于许峰来说，在这林子之中救人，就属于一种“高风险高回报”的事情，不提现在如何，就是对于许峰以后，都极有好处，阴德庇护，神灵得感，许峰感觉这一趟缝尸，给赵三一个完美的人生。
似乎也不是遥不可及的事情了。
毕竟有神灵相助，面对黄河妖尸，乃至于方术古尸，总算是有了自保之力。
况且，许峰想到第一次缝尸的时候，出现在自己身上的土地神增益。
指不定日夜游神，也能送自己增益。
喜滋滋，美滋滋。
许峰想东想西的时候，还抽空摸了摸自己脖子上的护身符。这护身符在林子里头，挡住了好几次看不见的攻击。
这林子的确凶险。
从最外头可以看到的，是那些个大树，长得千奇百怪，到了里头看不到的，是死在这里，叫此处地脉变化生成的阴祟鬼怪。
无论是这大树。
还是这阴祟鬼怪。
对于许峰这样的生人，都充满恶意。
他们到了林子里头，却未曾深入，在林子外围挖尸骨。

在这林子外围的尸骨，都埋的不深。
轻轻几铲子就能将其启出来。
有的更是直接连手都在外头，半个身子没有进土，这样的尸体用手拉，都能从地里拉出来。
不过愈是往下挖，尸骨的完整程度就愈是不好了。到了一定程度上，就能看到树木的根须，这些树木的根须，将尸骨缠绕的严严实实，想要在那里救人，就须得有一柄“神兵利器”，将树木根须铲断。
他手里的这铲子，不行。
缝尸人亦不许许峰往下挖，用他的话说，再往下挖，就是“吃力不讨好”了。
可就算是如此，在种种加持之下——煞刀、白日、师父护法、香灰、火盆、香路等的护佑，许峰还是危险连连！也不多说，就是那树枝往下抽打，就不是一般人能受住的。
那一下抽出来，就是连皮带肉一鞭子血！一根树枝不怎样，可是数根树枝下来，就算是铁人也受不住这打！
且不提树枝，还有树根。
树根故意绊人。
来到那里，就是上下皆敌！起初许峰心中的确是有些忐忑，可是在看到了这文字的时候，许峰勇猛无敌了起来
也不含糊，哪怕知道粗壮的树根，自己一铲子铲不断，他也不管。
只顾着奋力挥舞起来了自己手边的铁锹，狠狠地铲下去，哪怕只是将这树根砍杀的破皮，流血，那也够了！
就是这样，许峰也数不清楚自己到底在里头启出来了多少尸骨，他只是记得自己最后都快要成“潜意识反应”。
连自己师父，差点都挨了一铲子。
并且还有一说，叫许峰开了眼，那就是这些尸骨无论在土里，或者是半掩在土里的时候，多么的完整、栩栩如生。
可是一旦被许峰和师父掏出来，立刻就“皮烂骨酥”。
登时无人形，失皮囊真意。
每见到这般情形一次，师父都会鼓掌说道“好好好”！
这就是解脱！

就如此，师徒二人今日之行，也算是“功德圆满”，走在回家路上。
可真正剧烈运动的时候，许峰的体内，自然是有各种气血、精力顶着。
这一脱战回来，等到了那一口子气褪了，那浑身的疼痛，就如潮水一般涌上来。
content_en:
Somewhat exhausted, he returned to the car. The master did not stop, packed up all the things placed next to the forest, and put them all towards the car. Xu Feng and the master immediately walked back.
Even on the road, Xu Feng was still in the mood to think about the words he saw in the woods.
God of land and wandering day and night.
He had never thought that the foundational foundation mentioned by Master would be such an immediate thing.
But if I ask him to do it again——
Xu Feng is still willing to come again.
After all, in this forest, risks and opportunities really coexist.
And for Xu Feng, rescuing people in this forest is a "high-risk, high-reward" thing. Not to mention what it is now, it will be extremely beneficial to Xu Feng in the future. With the protection of Yin De and the inspiration of the gods, Xu Feng feels that this trip to sew corpses will give Zhao San a perfect life.
It doesn't seem to be something out of reach.
After all, with the help of the gods, he finally had the power to protect himself in the face of the Yellow River demon corpse and even the ancient corpse of Fang Shu.
Moreover, Xu Feng thought of the Earth God's buff that appeared on his body when he sewed a corpse for the first time.
Maybe the day and night wandering god can also give himself a buff.
Happy, happy.
While Xu Feng was thinking about something, he took the time to touch the amulet around his neck. This amulet was in the woods, blocking several invisible attacks.
This forest is indeed dangerous.
What can be seen from the outside are those big trees with all kinds of strange shapes. What can't be seen from the inside are the sinister ghosts that died here and were caused by the changes in the earth's veins.
No matter it is this big tree.
Still this sinister ghost.
They are full of malice towards strangers like Xu Feng.
They reached the forest, but did not go deep into it. They dug up corpses on the outskirts of the forest.
The bones on the outskirts of the forest were not buried deep enough.
It can be opened with a few shovels.
Some of them even had their hands outside, and half of their bodies were not buried in the ground. Such corpses could be pulled out of the ground by hand.
But the deeper you dig, the worse the integrity of the bones becomes. To a certain extent, you can see the roots of the trees. The roots of these trees tightly entwine the bones. If you want to save people there, you must have a "magic weapon" to cut off the roots of the trees.
The shovel in his hand won't work.
The stitcher also did not allow Xu Feng to dig deeper. In his words, digging further would be "a thankless job."
But even so, with all kinds of blessings - the protection of the evil sword, the white sun, the master's protector, the incense ashes, the brazier, the incense road, etc., Xu Feng is still in danger! Needless to say, it is not something that ordinary people can withstand when the branches are whipped downwards.
When he pulled it out, his skin and flesh were all whipped with blood! One branch isn't much, but if several branches come down, even an iron man won't be able to withstand the beating!
Not to mention the branches, there are also roots.
The roots of the tree deliberately trip people up.
Once you get there, you will be enemies from above and below! Xu Feng was indeed a little uneasy at first, but when he saw this text, Xu Feng became brave and invincible.
Not ambiguous, even if he knew that he could shovel away the thick roots of the tree, he wouldn't care.
He just waved the shovel in his hand vigorously and shoveled it down hard. Even if it only broke the skin of the tree roots and caused bleeding, that was enough!
Even so, Xu Feng couldn't count how many corpses he had uncovered inside. He just remembered that he was about to have a "subconscious reaction" in the end.
Even his master almost got a shovel.
Another thing that opened Xu Feng's eyes was how complete and lifelike these corpses were, whether they were in the soil or half-covered in the soil.
But once it was taken out by Xu Feng and Master, his skin was rotten and his bones were rotten.
Suddenly there was no one, and the true meaning of the skin was lost.
Every time he sees such a situation, Master will applaud and say "good, good, good"!
This is the solutionTake it off!
In this way, the master and the apprentice's trip today can be regarded as a "complete success" and they are walking on their way home.
But when exercising really strenuously, Xu Feng's body was naturally filled with all kinds of qi, blood and energy.
After returning from the battle, when the breath subsided, the pain all over my body surged up like a tide.
